correctness.rationale: PASS applies to the corrected RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt in /workspace/repairs/2, not to the frozen universal vanishing sentence. Frozen RESULT.md lines 13 and 50 and the original slogan omit the stabilization exception: F_3=F_4, so the map on H_4=Z at 3→4 is the identity, contradicting 'every consecutive inclusion.' The only zero transitions before stabilization are 0→1, 1→2, 2→3 (the source and target have disjoint positive homological degrees); all maps at or beyond 3 are identities. The repaired finding states these maps and the four corresponding interval summands, and retains the valid homotopy and character claims. I reconstructed all faces by testing the edge count on each connected component and the induced degrees, then audited the four original JSON operation lists by checking every cover relation against its pair assignment and its deletion index. Every unmatched downward Hasse arrow strictly increases the index and the upward matched arrows are disjoint at equal index, proving acyclicity. The pair counts were 15,38,79,94, and the critical cells are one vertex plus respectively one 1-cell, one 2-cell, seven 3-cells and one 4-cell. Discrete Morse gives the four stated wedges since no other cells intervene. Separately counted fixed faces using the number of permutation cycles on each face (signed Euler contribution (-1)^(cycles−1)); all 32 stage-two/three traces matched. The vertex permutation module less the alternating line gives exactly the stage-two character; its rotation constituents over Q have cyclotomic polynomials x−1, x²+1, x⁴+1 and reflection preserves each. The final line has r→−1 and s→+1. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/recheck_2.py uses the original certificate data without executing the submitted verifier. The frozen verification notes and script certify the four distinct stages, not a zero map beyond the last one. The original review and audit annotations remain historical evidence, not a certification of the repair.

value.rationale: The repaired claim settles the higher degree-bounded and unrestricted forest complexes on a canonical cubic nonplanar graph rather than repeating the known degree-one sphere. Seven new critical classes in degree three and one stabilized degree-four class complete its integral persistence. The rational symmetry calculation distinguishes the unique invariant line in the former from the rotationally odd terminal class, exact information not determined by the sphere ranks alone.
